interpretation: Random-seed performance follow-up; source and normal-code identities reuse bounded prior validation. This is not a new leakage test.

protocol.analysis: Process medians -> paired block effects -> session medians -> median of five session estimates
protocol.box_definition: Inclusive interpolated quartiles of 60 block effects; pooled block median; full min-max whiskers; all dots retained; descriptive only
protocol.exclusions: No trimming or timer overhead subtraction; any failed execution, source/assembly identity, round trip or integrity check invalidates the attempt
protocol.fixture_rule: Saved block seed shared by all variants and encoded with parameter, phase and iteration by derand-shake256-v1
protocol.stopping: Five separately launched complete sessions; retain failed attempts; no effect-dependent reruns or extension

session_note: Break, physical placement and thermal conditions not recorded
